steps.command:
set -euo pipefail
test -d /shared/helix-r24
sudo test -f /srv/helix-r24-store/disk.img
sudo test ! -L /srv/helix-r24-store/disk.img
test "$(sudo stat -c '%U:%G:%a:%s' /srv/helix-r24-store/disk.img)" = 'root:root:600:2147483648'
sudo blkid -p -o export /srv/helix-r24-store/disk.img
if ! mountpoint -q /shared/helix-r24; then sudo mount -o loop,prjquota,allocsize=4k /srv/helix-r24-store/disk.img /shared/helix-r24; fi
test "$(findmnt -n -M /shared/helix-r24 -o FSTYPE)" = xfs
source="$(findmnt -n -M /shared/helix-r24 -o SOURCE)"
test "$(sudo losetup --noheadings --output BACK-FILE "$source")" = /srv/helix-r24-store/disk.img
findmnt -n -M /shared/helix-r24 -o SOURCE,FSTYPE,OPTIONS
sudo losetup -j /srv/helix-r24-store/disk.img
sudo xfs_quota -x -c 'state -p' /shared/helix-r24
sudo exportfs -o rw,sync,no_subtree_check,root_squash 172.31.0.221:/shared/helix-r24
sudo exportfs -o rw,sync,no_subtree_check,root_squash 172.31.0.222:/shared/helix-r24
sudo exportfs -v
sha256sum /shared/helix-r24/operator-witness/*.txt
